name: HandBrake-AMD-AMF-VCE
description: HandBrake is a tool for converting video from nearly any format to a selection of modern, widely supported codecs. The GUI of the application is accessed through a modern web browser (no installation or configuration needed on the client side) or via any VNC client. A fully automated mode is also available: drop files into a watch folder and let HandBrake process them without any user interaction. This container has a copy of the AMD driver in it to allow encoding with AMD VCE acceleration. I have only tested this sofar on one machine with an 7940hs igpu. AV1 worked there. You should install the Radeon TOP first though. This container is based on the work of Zocker160 and jlesage / JocelynLeSage. For a complete documentation of this container, see https://github.com/datpat/
